body:
WHAT
`/resume <id>` reloads a saved session: it replays the transcript file into the real message history (compactions applied, dangling tool calls repaired), restores the token ledger, label and overdrive flag, announces the session, and sends the frontend a `session_restored` event holding a render-ready list of messages with each tool call already paired with its result and harness scaffolding (system reminders, tool-result-only messages) removed. The next turn continues the same transcript file.

WHY
Without it the user gets only metadata or a blank chat after restart, or the model resumes from a history the provider rejects.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — `resumeSession()` (`Transcript.replay`, `createSession(id, messages, SessionStats.fromSnapshot)`, `announceSession()`, emits `session_restored`), `handleSlash` case 'resume', `reconstructForDisplay()`, `textOf()`, `flattenToolResult()`; engine/core/src/state/transcript.ts — `Transcript.replay()`, `repairToolPairing()`, `stripSystemReminders()`, `Transcript.latestMeta()`; engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — session constructor taking prior messages, the turn-end `meta` snapshot append (around line 1885) that resume reads back; protocol types engine/protocol/src/types.ts `RestoredMessage`, `RestoredToolCall`.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Using a FakeProvider, run a turn with a tool call and result, then /clear and /resume <id>; assert a session_restored event whose messages contain one assistant entry with toolCalls[0].tool, input and result text paired, and no standalone tool_result user message.
2. A user message stored as 'hello<system-reminder>…</system-reminder>' is restored as text 'hello'; a user message that was only a reminder or a compaction summary is omitted from the paint list.
3. After /resume, send another user message with the FakeProvider; assert the provider request contains the earlier messages (real context) and the transcript file for the old id gained new lines (same transcript continued).
4. /resume of an unknown id emits {type:'error', fatal:false} mentioning 'no such session'; /resume while a turn is busy emits a 'busy' command_output and does not switch sessions.
5. Resume a transcript whose meta snapshot has stats and label; assert the restored session's stats total equals the snapshot and session_started/session_list carry the label.
